# Replication and Source refresh

Replication keeps every Machine's copy of the Brain the same.
Source refresh reads new activity, and synchronously means something else.
Names in code are not prose: `syncNow`, `second brain`, and [a link](https://example.com/sync) target.
A hyphenated word such as sync-state or auto-saved-items is a different word.
Ordinary words the check leaves alone: an Obsidian vault, a data folder, a backup and the agent in a Harness.

```sh
attache sync
```
